selected.prompt: Make a color-only edit of this exact no-text technical drawing. Preserve EVERY component position, margin, scale, all grids/row and column counts, node counts, connectors, arrow direction, line endpoints, layer glyphs and label whitespace. Blue/cyan becomes muted #7188A3 and #E5EAF0; green#829C8B/E8EEE9; yellow/orange#B4A16F/F1ECDD; red/pink#A7787D/F0E5E6;purple#9588A5/ECE8F0. Except scientifically needed class divisions, do not use bright red/orange/cyan or multicolored rainbow. All ordinary rectangles gently rounded; preserve factor squares, matrix cells and feature-map silhouettes as meaningful shapes. Purewhiteflatbackground, no textures, no gradients, no text or pseudo text. rnn-attention-paths exact original canvas 1774×965px.
